record.field: Count supplies and reconcile on-hand stock

field.name: note
field.p: Count the product in Dental Supplies in individual stock units, converting unopened packs using the configured unit. Enter the physical count through Inventory and review any difference before applying it. Record a brief administrative handoff and launch the next check for the following week.

record.field: Review batch labels and expiration dates

field.name: note
field.p: For a lot-tracked product, compare its stock lots and expiration dates with the manufacturer's labels and review native expiration alerts. Handle affected stock through the practice's approved procedure. Enter the actual labeled expiration on each new receipt; this plan does not define clinical handling or shelf-life.

record.field: Review replenishment and open supplier orders

field.name: note
field.p: Review on-hand and forecast stock, open receipts, vendor pack size and lead time. Adjust the manual minimum and maximum for the practice's demand. Replenish only after review and check any existing RFQ before creating another. Assign receipt checking and vendor-bill review to the responsible staff.
